prompt: Create an original 90 second West African acoustic instrumental instrumental composition for puzzle game, strategy and patient problem solving. Mood: curious, playful, precise. Instruments: kora, balafon, calabash percussion. Style: interlocking plucked patterns and buoyant polyrhythm. Tempo approximately 110 BPM; C lydian. Main idea: a repeating five-note figure with space between phrases. Use offset accents and question-and-answer motifs without dramatic shocks. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:30] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:30-01:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:00-01:30] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:30.

description.en: A cheerful and upbeat acoustic track featuring a prominent plucked string melody, supported by a walking bassline and light, steady drums. The overall feel is bright and optimistic.
description.zh: 一首欢快活泼的器乐曲，以突出的拨弦乐器旋律为主，辅以行进的贝斯线和轻快的鼓点。整体感觉明亮乐观。
